model.carbon_boundary: Assumed material-factor accounting only, including pasta treatment; no carbonation uptake, no avoided-disposal credit, no full validated life-cycle assessment.
model.absolute_volume_convention: Total mix water plus dry-pasta volume; assumed bookkeeping requiring experimental calibration for porous pasta.

algorithm.name: NSGA-II
algorithm.selection: binary tournament by constrained-front rank, crowding distance, random tie break
algorithm.survival: parent+offspring elitist constrained sorting; last front truncated by crowding
algorithm.baseline: Uniform independent sampling within identical bounds; seed=10000+paired_NSGA_seed; same 8080 evaluations; retain feasible nondominated set.
algorithm.evaluation_budget_note: Counts sampled candidate evaluations only; reporting re-evaluations and optional deterministic replay are excluded. No outside archive is used in NSGA-II survival.

compromise_selection.formula: argmin sqrt(mean(((f-ideal)/span)**2)); equal weights in minimized-objective coordinates
compromise_selection.normalization_source: Feasible nondominated final population of main NSGA-II seed42; fixed for all NSGA-II and random-baseline compromise selections.
compromise_selection.limitation: A preference-dependent selection tied to the sampled set; it is not a unique universal optimum.

quality_indicator.name: IGD to joint empirical nondominated reference
quality_indicator.formula: mean over reference points of min Euclidean normalized-objective distance to candidate front
quality_indicator.reference_source: Nondominated union of five NSGA-II final fronts and five equal-budget random fronts
quality_indicator.limitation: The union is an empirical reference, NOT the true Pareto front. Smaller is better relative to this finite reference; there is no global optimality guarantee.

sensitivity.interpretation: Post hoc bookkeeping/stress tests of fixed nominal decision variables; NOT reoptimization or validated uncertainty intervals.
sensitivity.absorption_convention: B, s, effective w/b and dry pasta are fixed; extra water changes with absorption, sand is recomputed to close 1 m3. Strength and slump remain unchanged by construction of the synthetic response.
